summary: Cred and Duck return after a 2-month break to find the market consolidating near all-time highs on major assets. Both hosts are positioned bullish with existing positions from lower levels - Duck holding ETH from ~3K and both noting SOL from 130 support. The key theme is that while charts look bullish with higher lows forming, all-time high breakout trades have underperformed this cycle compared to previous cycles. They identify clear invalidation levels: BTC at 104-107K, ETH at 4K, and SOL at 190-200. Both are in 'investor mode' rather than active trading, preferring to hold existing positions rather than chase breakouts. They note retail excitement is notably absent despite being near all-time highs, which they interpret as potentially bullish given price action.
key_takeaways: BTC invalidation at 104-107K zone - if lost, expect chop toward 90-95K; cycle top not yet in according to both hosts
ETH 4K is the critical level to hold - broken resistance from 2021, expect at least one more push to take out all-time high
SOL at 190-200 invalidation with 300 as potential target, though breakouts have been 'drifty' rather than explosive
HYPE ticks all fundamental boxes (revenue, buybacks, product) - 'if you like the exchange just buy it' but approaching top 10 tends to slow momentum
All-time high breakout trades significantly underperforming vs previous cycles - better to already be positioned than chase
